description: CR 603.3b the ability triggered by another ability's triggering is placed SECOND, so it resolves first
note: History of Benalia on two lore counters gets its third in alice's precombat main phase (CR 715.3c), firing chapter III, and Historian's Boon's 'Whenever the final chapter ability of a Saga you control triggers' triggers off that triggering. CR 603.3b's second pass puts the Boon's above chapter III. With one trigger in each pass alice has nothing to order: an ordering prompt offering both would be unscheduled and fail the run. Chapter III is the one underneath because the Saga has three lore counters.
